stories.title: Meta’s new One subscriptions put a price on social media and AI
stories.simple_summary: Meta is now charging money for extra AI features and social media apps through subscription bundles.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Meta apps and want advanced AI features, you may need to pay a monthly fee instead of using them free.

stories.title: This doorbell camera lets a human security guard watch your front door
stories.simple_summary: SimpliSafe is selling a new doorbell camera ($199.99) that combines AI with human security guards who can watch your front door and respond to threats in real time.
stories.why_it_matters: If you want a smarter home security system, this is an option — but it costs extra money each month ($49.99+) to have a real person monitoring it alongside the AI.

stories.title: Salesforce and Nvidia’s new reasoning model is everything the AI labs should fear
stories.simple_summary: Salesforce and Nvidia created new AI software designed to help businesses with sales, marketing, and customer support tasks.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to large companies and investors — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: Gates Foundation warns AI could widen inequality as foundation pledges $1B to expand access - ABC News
stories.source: Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
stories.simple_summary: The Gates Foundation (a charity run by Bill Gates) warned that AI might make rich and poor people even more unequal, and they're spending $1 billion to try to help more people access AI benefits.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about long-term fairness in society, but the foundation is trying to make sure regular people benefit from AI, not just wealthy people and big companies.

stories.title: AI Is Transforming Business. Now It’s Transforming the MBA Classroom
stories.simple_summary: Business schools are now teaching students about AI and how it's changing work.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly affects MBA students and educators — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Jensen Huang took a call from Trump, and showed off something else, too
stories.simple_summary: The headline is too vague to explain clearly — it mentions Jensen Huang (a tech CEO) got a call from Trump and showed off some phone, but doesn't explain what happened.
stories.why_it_matters: Not enough information to say whether this matters to you.

stories.title: Sen. Kennedy readies AI ‘kill switch’ bill - Live Updates
stories.simple_summary: A senator is working on a bill that would give the government an "emergency stop button" for AI if something goes wrong.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about government policy and mostly affects lawmakers and tech companies — it's too early to know if it will become law.

stories.title: Is Big Tech’s AI slowdown a safety pact or a cartel?
stories.simple_summary: Top AI company leaders (like Elon Musk and Sam Altman) said they would slow down their AI development to make it safer, but some people think they might really just be trying to protect their business advantage.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech industry watchers and investors — the debate over AI safety is important, but doesn't directly affect your life right now.

stories.title: Barack Obama, Kamala Harris call for government action on AI development
stories.simple_summary: Barack Obama and Kamala Harris called for the government to take action and make rules about how AI is developed and used.
stories.why_it_matters: Government oversight of AI could eventually affect how AI products work in your life, but there's no specific action to take yet.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang tells Trump ‘we’re not going to let [an AI slowdown] happen’
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang told Trump he doesn't agree with slowing down AI development — he wants companies to keep moving fast.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech industry people — it shows disagreement among leaders about how fast AI should develop.

stories.title: Oklo Has Massive Potential Due to Artificial Intelligence, but the Stock Is Sinking. Here's What I'd Do
stories.simple_summary: The headline suggests a company called Oklo has potential because of AI, but its stock price is dropping anyway.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to stock investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: What execs and politicians are saying about slowing down AI development
stories.simple_summary: Business leaders and politicians are debating whether AI development should be slowed down for safety reasons or kept moving forward.
stories.why_it_matters: This debate could eventually affect future AI products and rules, but for now it's mostly discussion among decision-makers.
